seo.title: Protiti Sahajee Prachi | Aspiring QA Engineer
seo.description: Portfolio of Protiti Sahajee Prachi: CSE student at AIUB, aspiring QA engineer and researcher.

profile.pitch: I break software on purpose, so your users never do it by accident.
profile.about: I'm a Computer Science and Engineering student at AIUB, working toward a career in quality assurance. I've done hands-on Selenium testing, debugging and statistical analysis, and research taught me to question every result before I trust it. I use the same habit on software: find defects early, improve quality, and help ship products people can rely on.

projects.name: SkillHub
projects.overview: A learning platform where courses, lessons and progress live in one place, from the React screens through to the database.
points: Built a full-stack learning platform with a React and Next.js front end.
Wrote the FastAPI backend on top of a PostgreSQL database.

projects.name: Job Portal
projects.overview: A job board where people search openings, keep accounts, and apply, with listings and applicants stored in MySQL.
points: Developed a job portal web application with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP.
Stored jobs, applicants and accounts in a MySQL database.

projects.name: Zoo Management System
projects.overview: A desktop desk for day-to-day zoo work: tickets, memberships and transactions, tied to SQL Server.
points: Built modules for visitor ticketing, membership and transaction management.
Linked the database to a user-friendly WinForms interface for day-to-day zoo operations.

projects.name: Art Gallery Management System
projects.overview: A desktop catalog for a gallery: artworks, artists and sales, with create, read, update and delete on a relational database.
points: Developed a desktop application to manage artworks, artists and sales records.
Implemented CRUD operations with a relational database for secure storage and retrieval.

testingShowcase.name: Selenium test suite for Job Portal
testingShowcase.text: Automated end-to-end tests for sign-up, job search and applying, with a written test plan and bug reports.
